objective.name: sandbox.dsl.local.composite
objective.description: Local composite DSL flow mixing a local wrapper-backed call, a local engine-native call, and a branch.

#root.role: Compose local wrapper and local engine-native calls, branch on the engine response, and return one terminal local wrapper result.

effects.local_wrapper_runtime: The local wrapper runtime is invoked.
effects.local_engine_route: A local engine-native reflexive call is awaited.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local request becomes one terminal wrapper result after a composed local wrapper call, a local engine-native state read, and a branch driven by the state response.
invariants: The flow always performs one local wrapper call and one local read.state before evaluating the branch condition.
Exactly one terminal wrapper invocation is selected by the branch, and intermediate sub-responses are not exposed as terminal outputs.
Branch selection is driven only by local_state.payload.context.context_id.
success: On success, the terminal payload is the payload returned by the selected final sandbox.echo invocation.
When the local context id is /root/alpha_child, the echoed terminal message is the message returned by the first local wrapper call.
failure: The flow fails terminally if either the initial local wrapper step or the local read.state step cannot complete.
A terminal branch invocation failure closes the whole DSL capacity fail-closed.
notes: This scenario is the baseline local composition proof for N7.
The scenario validates sequence plus conditional routing without crossing context or instance boundaries.
